episodes.title: Alleged cult members target young girls?! (with English subs) | Kapuso Mo, Jessica Soho
episodes.description:
Aired (December 14, 2025): People going door-to-door in several barangays in Bukidnon were reportedly not carolers, but alleged cult members targeting young girls?!

Children “Erin” and “Sophia” were left with marks on their necks and thighs after different people allegedly tried to take them from inside their own homes!


Residents immediately searched for the people who were allegedly members of a cult reportedly targeting young girls in their area.

Will they find them? Watch the video. #KMJS

episodes.description:

Some were seen carrying flags and drums, while others allegedly performed rituals that included killing a bird.

Who are they, and what exactly are they doing in Cebu?

episodes.title: Alleged cult members found wandering in the PH (with English subs) | Kapuso Mo, Jessica Soho
episodes.description:
Aired (February 25, 2024): Residents in certain areas of Pangasinan are on edge due to reports of alleged cult members wandering through their neighborhoods. It is believed that these individuals are attempting to abduct young women and demand ransom. Fear intensified when a video surfaced showing a group participating in a procession, leading locals to suspect that this was the cult they had been hearing about. Who is behind the mysterious knocks that are causing anxiety among the residents?

Watch the video.
